subject: Mobile Development
title: Mobile Commerce Revolution
description: A 60-second lesson on Mobile Commerce Revolution.

hook.text: More than 70% of all e-commerce traffic now comes from mobile devices, not desktops.

buildup.text: Mobile wallets like Apple Pay and Google Pay made one-tap checkout frictionless.

discovery.text: Amazon's mobile app generates more revenue than most countries' entire retail sectors.

twist.text: Social commerce — buying directly through Instagram or TikTok — is the fastest growing segment.

climax.text: Mobile turned every moment into a potential shopping opportunity.

punchline.text: Your phone is the world's biggest shopping mall.

quiz.question: What percentage of e-commerce traffic comes from mobile?
